items.name: performance-optimization
items.title: Performance Optimization
items.description: Fix a performance problem by profiling first, making one targeted change, and verifying both the speedup and that correctness held. Use when a feature is measurably slow, a page or API exceeds its budget, or a query takes too long. Do not use to pre-optimize code that has not been measured.
items.author: Khaled Saeed
